title: TechFluence (Paper Presentation)
participants: Individual or Team of 2 members allowed.
rules:
1. Presentation Duration: Each team will be allotted a maximum 10 minutes for their presentation.
  2. Topic Allocation
  • Presentation topics will be assigned from a predefined list provided by the organizers.
  • Topics will be allotted only after confirmation of team registration.
  • Participants will receive the topic list and their assigned topic via email or WhatsApp, as per the communication details provided during registration.

  • Topic Selection Process
judging:
• Quality & clarity of content and structure [20 points]
  • Originality, Relevance and Creativity [20 points]
  • Presentation skills and confidence [20 points]
  • Technical Understanding [20 points]
  • Ability to answer questions effectively [10 points]
  • Judges’ Discretionary [10 points]
  1. Originality & Ethics
  • The content of the presentation must not be copied.
  • References or sources of information should be clearly cited where applicable.
  • Plagiarism in any form will result in immediate disqualification.

  • Final Authority

    • The decision of the judges will be final and binding on all participants.
    • Objections or Appeals of any type regarding the judgment will not be entertained.

additionalSections.title: Submission Guidelines
additionalSections.content:
• Presentation submission deadline: 06th September 2026 (by 11:30 AM)
  • On the day of the event, participants must submit a copy of their presentation in a Pen Drive at the registration desk.
  • The Pen Drive should be retrieved immediately after the team's presentation.
  • Language Requirement: The presentation must be delivered in English.

additionalSections.title: Q&A Session
additionalSections.content: A brief Q&A session (5 to 7 minutes) will follow each presentation. Participants should be prepared to respond to questions from the judges.
